Subject: RE: VSL-02 - OFF-HIRE DEDUCTION 11.5 HOURS ROTTERDAM

- Offhire: 4.0 hours
- Offhire amount: 2566.67 USD
- Reinstated: 7.5 hours
- Reinstated: 4812.5 USD

Best regards,
Brannock Agri Trading

Cc: mail01@lindenmaritime.example
Subject: RE: VSL-02 - OFF-HIRE DEDUCTION 11.5 HOURS ROTTERDAM

Dear Charterers,

Operator rejects: the certificate was valid and checked; the delay was the terminal berth being occupied; asks to reinstate the 11.5 hours.

- Offhire: 11.5 hours
- Delay cause: terminal berth occupied

Best regards,
Meridian Fleet Management

Best regards,
